verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an llms.txt file, an llms-full.txt, or docs written for AI agents to consume. The Discovery Documents are machine-readable API descriptions meant for building client libraries and tools, which is an adjacent building block rather than agent-oriented docs. The MCP servers belong to a separate story, and none of this earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
